data.one_liner: Easy Firebase phone authentication with OTP sending, verification, and auto-fetch support.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies phone number authentication using Firebase Auth by managing the OTP request and verification process. Features built-in SMS autofill support for Android and handles reCAPTCHA on Web automatically.
use_when: You are implementing Firebase phone authentication in your Flutter application.
You want automated SMS OTP auto-fetch support on Android.
You need a widget-based approach to manage phone verification states.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase as your backend authentication provider.
You require custom multi-factor authentication flows outside standard phone number verification.
strengths: Supports auto-fetch OTP via SMS on Android out of the box.
Handles cross-platform flows cleanly across Android, iOS, and Web.
Widget-based controller lifecycle ensures no state leaks between screens.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform configurations such as SHA-1/SHA-256 fingerprints on Android and custom URL schemes on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling Phone auth in the Firebase console, registering SHA certificate fingerprints on Android, and adding a custom URL scheme in iOS Info.plist.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use the official lower-level Firebase Auth SDK directly if you want full manual control over the phone verification code states and UI.
